# Arda elevation model and vectors (Middle-earth in 3D)

`app/src/main/assets/world/height.png`, `terrain.jpg` and `preview.jpg` are derived by
`tools/world/build_world.py` from the **Arda** project, https://github.com/bburns/Arda:

- `data/rasters/10k/dem.jpg`: a digital elevation model of Middle-earth created on the Outerra
  Worlds forum by **monks** and **Redrobes** from real-world elevation data, hand-editing and
  simulated erosion.
- `data/vectors/vectors.gpkg`: rivers, roads, forests, lakes, wetlands and place names (monks,
  SeerBlue, Redrobes and later maintainers).

The Arda project's code is MIT-licensed, but it states that the licence of the original DEM and
vector layers is **uncertain**. They're used here for this private, personal gift app only, with
this attribution; **don't publish or sell the app with these assets** without clarifying their
licence, as with the personal-use Aniron font.

Place positions for the journeys come from the same vectors (Cities, Towns, Citadels, place names).
